thought.text: 502s — the dev servers may have died during the outage, or the proxy can't reach `host.docker.internal`. Let me diagnose.

reasoning_content:
The proxy is returning 502 for all three. Either the dev server is down, or `host.docker.internal` inside the proxy container can't reach the host's dev port. Let me check:

1. Is the dev server process still alive (did the ~50 min gap + the initial boards crash take down all three)?
2. Does host.docker.internal resolve inside the proxy container?
3. Can I reach the dev port from the host (localhost:34237 etc.)?

action.command: echo "=== dev server procs ==="; ps aux | grep -E "[n]x [a-z]+:serve|[n]x run" | head -5; echo "=== dev ports on host ==="; (ss -tln 2>/dev/null | grep -E "34237|35581|38377") || echo "none of 34237/35581/38377 listening"; echo "=== proxy container host.docker.internal ==="; docker exec urbo-proxy getent hosts host.docker.internal 2>&1 | head -2; docker exec urbo-proxy wget -qO- --timeout=5 http://host.docker.internal:35581/ 2>&1 | head -c 120; echo
